description: Verify that TCP in any non-CLOSED/non-SYN-SENT/non-LISTEN state ignores a RST with OTW SEQ (RFC 793 §3.9 p69). 8 iterations exercise wst ∈ {SYN-RCVD, EST, FW1, FW2, CW, CLOSING, LA, TW}
approach:
[Objective]
A RST whose sequence falls outside the receive window cannot be authenticated against the connection — could be a blind off-path attack. RFC 793 §3.9 says ignore in every state where a connection exists (i.e., not LISTEN/SYN-SENT/CLOSED).

[Scenario — chronological]
8 iterations, one per state. Each: drive DUT to wst, tester sends RST with OTW SEQ, DUT must NOT respond.

[Pass condition]
No DUT response in any of the 8 phases.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: prelude failures (handshake / FIN / etc.) OR Fail_p<n>_unexpected_response — DUT acted on the OTW RST.

verdicts.Pass: DUT ignored OTW RST in all 8 states — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_unexpected_response: DUT response to OTW RST in SYN-RCVD
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 2 EST
verdicts.Fail_p2_unexpected_response: DUT response to OTW RST in EST
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 3 FW1
verdicts.Fail_p3_unexpected_response: DUT response to OTW RST in FW1
verdicts.Fail_p4_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 4 FW2
verdicts.Fail_p4_unexpected_response: DUT response to OTW RST in FW2
